Alex — thanks for the questions, good catches. Short answers below; attaching a one-page 'impact summary' as inline text and updated CSV (sig_v8_v9_diff.csv).

1) Q-2.14 (Data retention): This was a clarification in our documentation and default recommendation; product default for hosted deployments was updated to 7 days in June 2026 after customer feedback, but tenants can still configure retention up to 90 days via console or API. So the change is both a product default change (hosted) and reflected in v9 answers. Evidence: retention_policy.pdf excerpt (in evidence_index_acme.pdf) and an internal change log (link in index). No attestation required beyond evidence index unless your compliance team requires formal sign-off.

2) Q-5.1 (Access controls): MFA enforcement referenced in v9 is for Redwood operator/admin console access (internal personnel) — not customer end-users. Customers can require MFA for their application users but we do not enforce customer user MFA by default. Evidence: access_control_matrix.png (screenshot) and internal IAM policy excerpt.

Action plan:
- We've attached sig_v8_v9_diff.csv showing explicit old->new answers.
- If you want, we can produce a redline view with only customer-impacting changes (remove internal-only re-answers). I can have that to you by EOD tomorrow (Nov 6).
- If procurement needs attestation, we can route to Legal for a short attestation letter (2–3 business days).

Let me know if you want the customer-impacting subset; otherwise we consider this request closed once you confirm the two points above.

Regards,
